stories.title: UN Human Rights Chief ‘Appalled’ by Attacks on Airports Saudi Arabia

en.title: UN Human Rights Chief 'Appalled' by Attacks on Airports Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The UN Human Rights Chief expressed disapproval of attacks on airports in Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Ministers, Islamic Figures from Over 70 Countries Condemn Houthi Attacks Targeting Saudi Arabia

en.title: Ministers, Islamic Figures from Over 70 Countries Condemn Houthi Attacks Targeting Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Religious and government officials from more than 70 countries issued condemnations of Houthi attacks directed at Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: UN Human Rights Chief condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi airports

en.title: UN Human Rights Chief condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi airports
en.summary: The UN Human Rights Commissioner condemned repeated Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabian airports, noting that such actions violate international humanitarian law and calling for investigation and accountability.

stories.title: Islamic leaders condemn deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia that threaten safety of pilgrims

en.title: Islamic leaders condemn deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia that threaten safety of pilgrims
en.summary: Religious and political leaders from 176 countries condemned Houthi attacks in Riyadh that killed 12 and wounded 309, expressing concern about threats to pilgrims visiting Islam's holiest sites.

stories.title: Americans detained in Saudi Arabia over photos related to attacks, US embassy says

en.title: Americans detained in Saudi Arabia over photos related to attacks, US embassy says
en.summary: The US embassy reported that American citizens were detained by Saudi authorities for photographing recent events in Saudi Arabia following Houthi militia attacks. Saudi officials have warned against filming or sharing information related to counter-missile and drone operations and their impact sites.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s media minister urges public to rely on official information after Houthi attacks

en.title: Saudi Arabia's media minister urges public to rely on official information after Houthi attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Media Minister called on the public to use only official sources for information about security and military operations, following weekend Houthi attacks on Riyadh's airport that caused casualties and injuries.

stories.title: Riyadh Governor Reassures Those Injured in Houthi Attack: Saudi Leadership Stands with You Wholeheartedly

en.title: Riyadh Governor Reassures Those Injured in Houthi Attack: Saudi Leadership Stands with You Wholeheartedly
en.summary: The Riyadh Governor provided reassurance to those injured in the Houthi attack, expressing the Saudi leadership's support for the victims.

stories.title: Jordan king condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia during phone call

en.title: Jordan king condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia during phone call
en.summary: King Abdullah of Jordan condemned ongoing Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia during a call with Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, pledging Jordan's solidarity and support for Saudi security measures.

stories.title: Crown Prince Receives Call from King of Jordan Condemning Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: Crown Prince Receives Call from King of Jordan Condemning Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The King of Jordan called Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince to express condemnation of Houthi attacks against the Kingdom.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia extends suspension of operations at Riyadh airport following Houthi attacks

en.title: Saudi Arabia extends suspension of operations at Riyadh airport following Houthi attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority extended the suspension of operations at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh following Houthi attacks. The extension allows time for safety inspections and verification of airport facilities before resuming operations.

stories.title: R4 Group States reaffirm full support to Saudi Arabia to repel Houthi attacks

en.title: R4 Group States reaffirm full support to Saudi Arabia to repel Houthi attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, and Türkiye reaffirmed their solidarity and pledged full support for Saudi Arabia's measures to counter Houthi militia attacks and protect the kingdom's security and sovereignty.

stories.title: Global condemnation mounts over deadly Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh airport

en.title: Global condemnation mounts over deadly Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport
en.summary: Multiple countries and international organizations condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people and injured 309 civilians, with the UAE describing it as a violation of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty.

en.title: CMA receives 31 IPO applications in Q2 2026
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Capital Market Authority reported 31 pending initial public offering applications at the end of Q2 2026, comprising 17 for the Main Market and 14 for the Nomu-Parallel Market, with three approved on Nomu during the quarter.

stories.title: ‎Al Yamamah Steel’s contracts backlog hits SAR 1.1B: CEO

en.title: Al Yamamah Steel's contracts backlog hits SAR 1.1B: CEO
en.summary: Al Yamamah Steel Industries reported a contracts backlog valued at approximately SAR 1.1 billion and expects increased sales and profits in 2027 driven by expansion in electricity and renewable energy sectors.

en.title: SRC launches second mortgage-backed securities transaction
en.summary: Saudi Real Estate Refinance Company launched the kingdom's second residential mortgage-backed securities issuance, backed by SAR 420 million in mortgages and receiving top-tier credit ratings from Fitch and Moody's.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Oct. 8
en.summary: Major ownership changes occurred on the Tadawul stock exchange on October 8.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia attracts SAR 6T investments since strategy launch: Minister

en.title: Saudi Arabia attracts SAR 6T investments since strategy launch: Minister
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Investment Minister reported that domestic and international investments have reached approximately 6 trillion riyals since launching the National Investment Strategy. Gross fixed capital formation nearly doubled from 2020 to 2025, with private sector investment increasing from 59% to 77% of total investment.
